study: Wine vertical CID origins and metric encodings

profile.comparison: Complete exact RGB frames; no registration, tolerance, resampling or normalization. Diagnostic glyph cells are separate.

vertical-pilot.purpose: Pilot zero writing-mode metrics and independent y-origin decomposition before expanding views; positive vector shifts glyphs left one-eighth em and down one-quarter em.

vertical-defaults.purpose: Distinguish W2 array/range syntax and CID coverage from DW/DW2 default metrics. Defaults intentionally change PDF width metadata, never the font program; glyph transforms remain declared.

vertical-ranges.purpose: Confirmed responsive single-CID W2 ranges: geometry-equivalent x/y/split origins at three low zooms and two high zooms; positive syntax discriminators and independent cold source repeats.

limitations: Metric encoding differences are scoped observations, not a universal W2 support or parser-cause claim.
